title: Copier
description: A photocopier's light bar sweeps the glass, and whatever you do to the picture while it passes is printed into the copy — sway a face and it comes out as an S-curve. The copy stays on the glass for you to restyle in toner, Riso, fax or diazo, and feeding it back in loses a little more each generation.
intent: One slit-scan photocopier finished to the edge: the light bar records your hand into the print row by row, the copy waits on the glass until your next touch lifts it into the tray, and copying the copy compounds the distortion.
